# MakeHuman graphical sources

Retrieved 2026-09-10. These graphical assets are CC0 1.0. No MakeHuman application code is incorporated. `LICENSE.md` describes the code/assets split; `LICENSE.ASSETS.md` contains the asset licence. `source-hashes.json` records retained file integrity.

- `base.obj`: MakeHuman hm08, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/makehumancommunity/makehuman/master/makehuman/data/3dobjs/base.obj . Its header explicitly records CC0 release in September 2020 and copyright holders Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius and Jonas Hauquier. Only head/neck topology is extracted; body helpers are excluded.
- Female skin pack: https://files.makehumancommunity.org/asset_packs/skins01/skins01_cc0.zip . Licence and author listing: https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/skins01.html . Retained: `toigo_light_skin_with_natural_makeup` and `toigo_light_skin_female_freckles` by MargaretToigo; `onlytheghosts_old_eurasian_female` by OnlyTheGhosts. All three are explicitly listed as CC0.
- Male skin pack: https://files.makehumancommunity.org/asset_packs/skins02/skins02_cc0.zip . Licence and author listing: https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/skins02.html . Retained: `toigo_light_skin_male_bronze` by MargaretToigo, `onlytheghosts_old_eurasian_male` by OnlyTheGhosts, `jartur69_middleage_slavic_male_with_genitals_and_beard` by jartur69. All three are explicitly listed as CC0. Full original texture atlas files remain source assets, but runtime geometry only uses their head region.
- Hair pack: https://files.makehumancommunity.org/asset_packs/hair01/hair01_cc0.zip . Licence and author listing: https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/hair01.html . Only `toigo_curled_under_bob` (MargaretToigo/MRT) and `cortu_short_messy_hair` (Cortu Johnstone) are retained. Both MHCLO headers explicitly state CC0. Other inspected hairstyles with conflicting legacy headers were not retained.

Transforms: head cut at source Y 5.80; metre conversion and axis mapping in `hp`; per-character jaw/nose adjustments; neck boundary tucked under shirt. Hair is fitted with the MHCLO barycentric cage, scaled for haircut silhouettes and tinted. Skin images are resized to 1024 square and hair to 512 square in Blender; originals are preserved here. Embedded texture hashes are covered by each runtime GLB hash. Garments, shoes, hands, accessories, skeleton and animation remain authored in the project. No reference photo was projected onto the head and no exact likeness is claimed.

The optional game-dev CLI is unavailable. The existing project Blender pipeline and direct exported-byte validator are used; this is not represented as a canonical game-dev package or vendor-admit receipt.
